Static Unarmed Guards

A Professional Presence At Your Premises

About This Service

A dependable security presence starts with people who understand your premises. Ronin’s static unarmed guarding service is designed around the everyday needs of offices, warehouses and other business locations, helping maintain an orderly environment for staff, visitors and deliveries.

An agreed assignment can cover entrance monitoring, visitor registration, access checks, patrols and incident reporting. Clear instructions help guards recognise unusual activity, record concerns and alert the appropriate contact when further action is needed. Coverage hours and responsibilities are discussed around your site’s operating pattern.

Good guarding also involves communication. From directing visitors to supporting site procedures during an emergency, the role is to remain observant, approachable and prepared. Speak with our team about your premises, access points and priorities so we can discuss a suitable guarding arrangement.
